paragraphs: SmartDocs sells an AI-powered spend management platform for public sector procurement that brings sourcing, contracts, procurement, payables and documents into one place. The platform spans Smart Sourcing, Smart Procurement, Smart Payables and Smart Planning, covering vendor onboarding and solicitation through purchasing, invoices and payments.

Buyers named on the pages are state and local public procurement teams, from CFOs and controllers to procurement officers and AP managers. Sector headings on the home page cover state government, counties, cities, special districts, public utilities and tolling. An about page states that the company serves enterprises and public procurement teams nationwide.

The company sells software subscriptions with implementation and support services. Deployment is offered as cloud SaaS or on-premise. The platform offers deep SAP integration and connects with other ERPs, storage systems and business tools.

quote.text: Serving public buyers across every level of government and regulated industry.
